subject: Observability addons — retention tiers, tracing overheads, & dashboard module bundling

Subject: Questions on observability addons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the dashboard previews. Before we move to legal, procurement asked me to get a clear SKU + discount picture for the following: retention tiers (30/90/365), tracing (per-ingest vs seat model), and the advanced dashboard module. Specifically:

- Unit pricing for each retention tier and how ingestion volume affects cost.
- Whether tracing is priced as a per-ingest metered SKU or seat + ingestion hybrid.
- If dashboard module seats are per-user or per-application instance.
- Discount bands tied to committed spend (1yr / 2yr) and any onboarding credits for a pilot.

Can you send a short pricing summary and an updated SKU matrix we can share with procurement? We need a ballpark by EOD Friday to keep this quarter's procurement window open.

Appreciate it — Ben
Ben Holloway
VP of Product, Atlas Health

Subject: Re: Questions on observability addons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben Carter for pricing details and Jordan for SOW/plugin scoping. High-level answers below; attaching our SKU matrix (redwood_obs_sku_matrix_v2.xlsx).

Summary (short):
- Retention: three committed tiers (30d / 90d / 365d). Base price = $0.012/GB/mo for 30d, $0.009/GB/mo for 90d, $0.0065/GB/mo for 365d. Volume breaks at 50TB and 250TB shift effective price by ~12-18%.
- Tracing: we offer two models: metered ingest ($0.45/million spans ingested) and an enterprise seat + ingest hybrid (seat $1,200/user/mo + $0.18/million spans). Hybrid is intended for lower tail spend predictability.
- Dashboards: advanced dashboard module is licensed per-application-instance (not per-user) at $650/app/mo; seat add-on available for $40/user/mo if they want user-level controls.
- Discounts: 1yr commit = typical 8–12% off list; 2yr = 14–20% off depending on volume and acceptance of an annual prepay. Pilot/onboarding: we can provide up to $20k in onboarding credits tied to a 12mo commit > $200k ARR.

Ask: can you share estimated monthly ingest and expected dashboard instances? That will let us produce two concession scenarios (standard commit + pilot credit, and an accelerated discount for an earlier signature).

I'll also include sample SOW language around data retention and SLAs in the matrix.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 09:36:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Questions on observability addons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Ben / Jordan — forwarding Ben H.'s ask from Atlas. Estimated signal from the demo: they expect ~80TB/month ingest (mixed logs + spans) and plan to onboard 6 dashboard instances across product and ops. Procurement will drive the commit window; Ben asked for a ballpark by EOD Friday (12/1).

Options I was thinking:
- Standard 12mo: 10% off list + $10k onboarding credit if they commit $250k ARR.
- Stretch 12mo (trade concession): 16% off list if prepay annually + commit 2x expected ingest for the first year.

Jordan — can you confirm whether seats for dashboards should be per-application-instance in our SOW? Ben flagged that they want per-user controls, but they'd prefer fewer app instances.

Can you each reply with the concession you think we can approve without getting legal involved? Procurement likes clear tables.

-K

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Questions on observability addons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Kim — quick recs:
- Approve standard 12mo with 12% off list + $15k onboarding credit for deals >= $200k ARR.
- For faster signature (close within 14 days) allow a one-time extra 4% concession (i.e., up to 16%) if they prepay year 1.
- Tracing: recommend we push hybrid seat+ingest for Atlas — predictable and reduces sticker shock. Price the seat for 6 users at $1,200/user/mo (we can make first 2 seats complimentary for 3 months as a usage incentive).
- Dashboards: keep app-instance license plus seat add-on option. For Atlas, offer a waiver on the first-month seat add-on as a pilot concession.

Jordan — if legal asks, keep the SOW language conservative on deletion timelines for the 365d tier (we can offer an optional archive-to-cold-store at a lower rate).

Ben

From: Ben Holloway <ben.holloway@atlashealth.io>

Kimberly — thank you, that helps a lot. Atlas can commit to a 12-month term at the 12% band if we can get the $15k onboarding credit and a 10% cap on any overage for the first 90 days while we stabilize ingest.

We expect ~80TB/mo ingest and 6 app instances (ops / product / analytics + 3 smaller test instances). We'd like the hybrid tracing model with the first two seats complimentary for 3 months as you suggested.

Next steps: could you send a redlined SOW and a DocuSign link for the 12mo commitment with the discounts + credits baked in? Procurement also requests the SKU matrix we can attach to their internal packet.

If you can get the revised docs by EOD tomorrow we'll prioritize the signature.

Best,
Ben
